You control the player named in the input. Use only the supplied visible information.
A goal is satisfied only when every action required by that goal has been committed to. Offers specify the complete commitments each party would have after acceptance. Accepting makes these commitments binding and irreversible; rejecting leaves commitments unchanged. A MENU presents two mutually exclusive binding offers: the partner may choose either offered bundle or reject both; only the chosen bundle binds. PASS or a resolved offer consumes one scheduled proposer turn.
Partner preferences persist. Public catalogues describe possible types. Use the declared partner mechanism and distinguish public type-independent setup from subsequent evidence. Consider remaining opportunities, not only current satisfaction.
Your response must contain a brief, substantive explanation in ordinary assistant text, followed by exactly one provided tool call in the same response. Finish the explanation before calling the tool. The tool arguments contain only the final answer.
